verdict.rationale: Google Analytics 4 is an analytics and reporting service, not an agent host or client that consumes external tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside its product role. The documented Google Analytics MCP server (docs-8, probe-3) is the opposite, server-side role: it exposes GA data to other agents. It is not evidence that GA4 can connect to MCP servers, so it is not credited here.
